targetCondition.pageTitle: All models - The Rolex Watch Collection | Rolex® (US)
targetCondition.marketVerification: Official /en-us/ route and page title ends with (US); cards display $... USD. Visible cookie panel was rejected using the no-consent action.

networkDiscovery.fallbackTool: same-origin browser fetch after observed request-file export failed
networkDiscovery.notes: Chrome DevTools network list showed the official Rolex /api/catalog/watchgrid endpoint called during View more clicks, countryCode=US and language=en-us, through numberOfResults=1872 (HTTP 200). Direct response-file export was denied because the path was outside configured roots; an in-page same-origin fetch of the observed endpoint succeeded. Volatile searchUid response metadata was omitted from evidence. An unrelated Coveo analytics request failed DNS; catalog requests succeeded. No cookies, authorization headers, tokens or personal data were persisted.

primaryCollectionPath.type: official structured endpoint observed in actual browser network
primaryCollectionPath.pagination: Actual UI requests cumulatively increased numberOfResults 432, 576, 720, 864, 1008, 1152, 1296, 1440, 1584, 1728, 1872 with firstResult=0. Final UI state rendered 1,465 unique product cards and View more disappeared. A same-origin request with firstResult=1465, numberOfResults=1872 returned HTTP 200, totalCount=1465, zero results.

renderedCrossCheck.view: Model view; group=0; no restrictive collection, size, material, or new-model filters; clicked View more until absent.
renderedCrossCheck.officialResultsLabelAfterFullEnumeration: 1400 Results (actual DOM and API contain 1,465 unique products).

listingStatusBasis.reason: Six US official product pages across multiple collections, including lowest and highest prices, displayed public USD prices. All showed only “Contact a jeweler” linking to https://www.rolex.com/en-us/store-locator; no add-to-cart, online order, or checkout route appeared. Six separate official price APIs returned a public price. The common detail-page purchase route supports this status for the full price list.

tax.sourceText: Suggested retail price before applicable taxes.
tax.source: Official price API notices on six sampled US product pages; existing top-level history metadata preserved because applicable tax varies by state/locality.

errors: Chrome DevTools response-file export was denied by configured workspace-root checks; same-origin browser fetch fallback succeeded.
Unrelated Coveo analytics search request failed DNS; official Rolex watchgrid and price endpoints succeeded.
